name: Gargoyle
description: Medium monstrous humanoid (earth) with 4 RHD. Winged stone-skinned creatures with DR 10/magic, freeze, and flight. LA +5.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Gargoyles can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: DR 10/magic
ability.description: Damage reduction 10/magic. Gargoyle natural weapons are treated as magic for the purpose of overcoming DR.

ability.name: Freeze (Ex)
ability.description: A gargoyle can hold still to appear as a stone statue. Spot DC 20 to notice it is alive.

ability.name: No Sustenance
ability.description: Gargoyles require no food, water, or air.

ability.name: Stone Concealment
ability.description: +8 additional racial bonus on Hide checks when concealed against a background of stone (stacks with the general +2 Hide).

name: Grimlock
description: Medium monstrous humanoid with 2 RHD. Blind subterranean savages with blindsight, scent, and immunity to gaze and visual effects. LA +2.

ability.name: Blindsight 40 ft.
ability.description: Grimlocks maneuver and fight as well as a sighted creature by using scent and acute hearing within 40 feet.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft. (60 ft. upwind, 15 ft. downwind).

ability.name: Immune to Gaze and Visual Effects
ability.description: Because they have no true sight, grimlocks are immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, illusions, and other forms of attack that rely on sight.

ability.name: Battleaxe Proficiency
ability.description: A grimlock is automatically proficient with the battleaxe.

ability.name: Stone Camouflage
ability.description: +10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountainous or underground terrain.

name: Satyr
description: Medium fey with 5 RHD. Woodland reveler with DR 5/cold iron, magical pan pipes, and natural Perform/stealth aptitude. LA +2.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A satyr can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination.

ability.name: Head Butt
ability.description: Natural weapon: Head butt (1d6 bludgeoning).

ability.name: Pipes (Su)
ability.description: When a satyr plays its pan pipes, all creatures within 60 ft. (except satyrs) must succeed on a DC 13 Will save or be affected by charm person, sleep, or fear (satyr's choice, caster level 10th). A creature that saves cannot be affected by the same pipes for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based. The pipes are only magical in a satyr's hands.

name: Janni
description: Medium native outsider with 6 RHD. Weakest of the genies; flight, resistance to fire 10, telepathy, and genie spell-like abilities. LA +5.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Janni can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Resistance to Fire 10
ability.description: Janni have resistance 10 to fire damage.

ability.name: Elemental Endurance (Ex)
ability.description: Janni can survive on any inner plane (Air, Earth, Fire, Water) for up to 48 hours; beyond that, they take 1 HP of damage per hour until they return to the Material Plane.

ability.name: Plane Shift (Sp)
ability.description: A janni can enter any of the elemental planes, the Astral Plane, or the Material Plane (up to 8 additional creatures linked by hand). Otherwise as the plane shift spell, caster level 13th.

ability.name: Telepathy 100 ft.
ability.description: Janni can communicate telepathically with any creature within 100 ft. that has a language.

ability.name: Change Size (Sp)
ability.description: Twice per day, a janni can magically change a creature's size as enlarge person or reduce person (can affect the janni). Fortitude DC 13 negates. Save DC is Charisma-based.

name: Svirfneblin (Deep Gnome)
description: Small humanoid (gnome). Deep Underdark gnome subrace with darkvision 120, SR (11 + class levels), +2 saves, nondetection, and rogue-like stealth. LA +3.

ability.name: Darkvision 120 ft.
ability.description: Svirfneblin can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A svirfneblin can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination.

ability.name: Stonecunning
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Search checks to notice unusual stonework, passive search within 10 ft., can find stonework traps as a rogue, and can intuit depth underground.

ability.name: Svirfneblin Luck
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on all saving throws. Replaces the rock gnome's +2 vs. illusions.

ability.name: Illusion DC +1
ability.description: +1 to the DC of all saving throws against illusion spells cast by a svirfneblin. Stacks with similar effects.

ability.name: Enmity vs. Kobolds and Goblinoids
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids.

ability.name: Dodge All Creatures
ability.description: +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against all creatures. Replaces the rock gnome's dodge bonus against giants.

ability.name: Nondetection (Su)
ability.description: Continuous nondetection effect as the spell (caster level equals class levels).

ability.name: Craft (Alchemy)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

ability.name: Underground Concealment
ability.description: +2 additional racial bonus on Hide checks underground (stacks to +4 total).

name: Forest Gnome
description: Small humanoid (gnome). Woodland gnome subrace. Pass without trace at will, enmity vs. reptilians, and strong Hide in forests. LA +0.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A forest gnome can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination.

ability.name: Weapon Familiarity
ability.description: Forest gnomes treat gnome hooked hammers as martial weapons.

ability.name: Illusion Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusions.

ability.name: Illusion DC +1
ability.description: +1 to the DC of all saving throws against illusion spells cast by a forest gnome. Stacks with similar effects.

ability.name: Enmity vs. Kobolds/Goblinoids/Orcs/Reptilians
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against kobolds, goblinoids, orcs, and reptilian humanoids. Replaces the rock gnome's +1 vs. kobolds/goblinoids only.

ability.name: Dodge Giants
ability.description: +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant type.

ability.name: Craft (Alchemy)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

ability.name: Pass without Trace (Su)
ability.description: Self only, as a free action, as the spell cast by a druid of the forest gnome's class levels.

ability.name: Woodland Concealment
ability.description: +4 additional racial bonus on Hide checks in a wooded area (stacks to +8 total).
